Its rectangle shape and thin profile make it easy to integrate into DIY electronics, solar-powered fans, lights, mobile charging projects systems. The water-resistant epoxy surface adds durability for indoor and light outdoor use. With simple solder tabs or terminals, the panel is easy to wire in series or parallel for custom voltage and current setups. It’s a perfect fit for hobbyists, students, and engineers working on sustainable energy projects or off-grid power prototypes.
